name: task-edge-tables-no-properties
body: The task-edge rel tables (AssignedTo/Implements/Target and the 20 per-kind create/modify/delete/move/rename tables) carry no serialized-properties column, because SCHEMA.md task edges have no properties today. Limit: an authored plan edge that later needs metadata cannot be stored on these tables. Upgrade when a plan edge needs metadata: move those tables onto the durable-edge path and add a properties column.
